answer: Sponsored surety: the garden admits a recruit when a sponsor locks 2,400 POA for 16 epochs, no yield. The sponsor posts a vine on a public atlas that binds their key to the recruit and freezes the sum. Each epoch a random juror checks that key still signs and payment trails miss other vines. A proven clone or shared purse pays the 2,400 POA to reporters and cuts 10% of the sponsor's bond. One honest seat parks 2,400 POA; 200 fakes lock 480,000 POA, above ~900 POA a shell extracts before a probe. Weakness: sold endorsements; cap three vines per sponsor and slash shared-source sureties together.
